Basic Page
Research Methodology
Psychologists have a range of options when studying developmental psychology.  Three major categories of research methodology they may use include:- descriptive research (includes naturalistic observation, surveys, and case studies)- correlational research- experimental research
Each of these main categories will be discussed in turn.
